name: 3 John
lede: The sixty-fourth book of the Bible, in full: the elder's letter unto Gaius the beloved — I pray that in all things thou mayest prosper; greater joy have I none than this, to hear of my children walking in the truth; a faithful work toward the brethren and strangers; fellow-workers for the truth; Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence; imitate not that which is evil, but that which is good; Demetrius hath the witness of all men; not with ink and pen, but face to face; the friends salute thee, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: Gaius the Beloved
books.blurb: The elder unto Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth; I pray that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth; greater joy have I none than this, to hear of my children walking in the truth; thou doest a faithful work toward them that are brethren and strangers withal; we ought to welcome such, that we may be fellow-workers for the truth; Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not; imitate not that which is evil, but that which is good; Demetrius hath the witness of all men; I am unwilling to write with ink and pen, but we shall speak face to face; peace be unto thee; the friends salute thee.
